items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 with lower prices
points: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, its first frontier models since Amodei's call for a slowdown, CNBC reports.
VentureBeat and Quartz report a 20% API price cut, and Anthropic says the models set record benchmark highs.
Fable 5.2 is available now, while access to Mythos 5.2 remains restricted, SQ Magazine and Breakingthenews report.
items.for_you: Developers on Anthropic's API can switch to Fable 5.2 now at the reported lower prices, but Mythos 5.2 access is limited.
